cohort: The study included 14 patients who underwent fetoscopic repair of fetal myelomeningocele (fMMC) between April 2018 and October 2023.
finding: Acute histologic chorioamnionitis (HCA) was diagnosed in 57% of patients after fetoscopic myelomeningocele repair and was significantly associated with earlier preterm premature rupture of membranes, earlier gestational age at delivery, lower birth weights, and longer NICU stays.
followup_time: Up to 63 days post-birth (or NICU discharge)
birth_weight: Median birth weights were 1470 g (with HCA) and 2900 g (without HCA).
gest_age: Median gestational age at PPROM ranged from 28 to 35.9 weeks, and median gestational age at delivery ranged from 31.1 to 36.9 weeks.
